en: This is...

jp: まだ乾ききってないってことは
そんなに時間もたっていない
en: A pool of blood... It hasn't dried yet, so it can't have been long.

jp: 誰がこんなことを・・・
en: Who would do this...

jp: 微かに匂う、この腐臭・・・
en: That faint smell... the stench of rot...
No doubt about it!! Pasca! They've shown up here!!
Pasca!?

jp: 血だまりの中に食い残しの断片が
en: There are half-eaten scraps lying in the blood...

jp: パスカに食われたんだ
en: Whoever was here got eaten by Pasca.

jp: 悪魔は殺されたらみんなパスカに
されるんじゃなかったの！？
en: Eaten...? I thought demons who got killed were all turned into Pasca!?

jp: 奴らのやり方も変わってきたんだ
弱い奴はパスカの食料
強い奴だけがパスカにされる
en: Their ways have changed. The weak are food for the Pasca. Only the strong get turned.
...No way.

jp: アラギの奴、昔はこんなことを
する奴じゃなかったのに！！
en: Damn it... Aragi never used to be the kind to do something like this!!
Why...

jp: ペインリングの封印なんか
en: Why did he have to go and break the seal on the Pain Ring!!

jp: そんなものなくたって
アイツは十分強かったはずなのに
en: He was strong enough without it. So why...
Aragi... He's already dead.
...Huh?

jp: アベルに殺されてしまった
en: Abel killed him, right in front of us.
No way. You're kidding, right?
It's no joke.

jp: アンタ達を疑うつもりはないけど
俺にはまだ信じられない
en: I'm not saying I doubt you, but I still can't believe it.

jp: ルカさん達を捜しましょう！
en: Never mind that now. Let's find Luca-san and the others!
Yeah, this way!!
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
